On Tue, Mar 27, 2012 at 5:18 AM, <ffsa...@gmail.com> wrote:
> scale_colour_manual is not any more seen in Deducer under the scales tab is
> that a bug? Please can you return that back like before.

One change in the new version of Deducer is that scales only appear
for those aesthetics that are in the plot, so if you are not coloring
the plot by a variable, the color scales won't show up. If you are,
then they will be there (including scale_manual).

> other point under the breaks of scale y, I enter all the break points to
> appear in the axis but this can be a tiresome task if too many break points.
> my suggestion is to include a UP and DOWN buttons to adjust the order of the
> break points instead of repeating to write everyone again if I would like to
> change the plot. So please add the up and down button in the dialog box
> where on enters the values of the breaks.

you are more than welcome to submit a patch implementing the features
that you want to see.
